response.justification: Bogdan brings roughly 15+ years of hands-on engineering across web, mobile, embedded, and high-throughput backend systems, plus founder experience with an open-source geo-data platform and a strong record of teaching and conference talks. However, the role is a director-level individual contributor focused on AI strategy, and the resume shows no demonstrated AI/ML depth (only recent MCP/agent tooling contributions), no cloud platform strategy or customer/partner advisory experience, and no evidence of operating at principal/director scope. Titles have plateaued at Senior/Staff Software Engineer, and the profile reads as a strong hands-on generalist rather than a recognized AI expert who can shape product direction for a cloud platform.
strengths: 15+ years of broad engineering across web, embedded, and low-latency distributed systems
Founder of an open-source geo-data platform with real users and Kubernetes deployment
Strong craftsmanship and communication: TDD, CI/CD, open-source libraries, workshops and conference talks
concerns: No demonstrated AI/ML expertise or AI products/platforms shipped at scale
Career level is Senior/Staff IC; no evidence of director-level scope or org-wide influence
Little cloud platform strategy or strategic customer/partner advisory experience

key_factors.factor: Breadth and depth of engineering experience
